profile.headline: Principal Software Developer  |   Ex-Oracle
profile.summary: Enrique has worked in software and telecom companies for which he has applied his knowledge and has gained experience as a software developer and skills as a problem solver.  Enrique has been working on a diversity of algorithms since he has finished his undergraduate studies (algorithms for mobile devices, standalone applications, distributed algorithms, web applications, GIS applications). During early stages of his professional carrer he lead research projects for 3G mobile applications. Afterwards, Enrique was involved on location algorithms for sensor networks during his postgraduate studies in Canada.  Furthermore, Enrique has worked for important IT companies such as Telcel, Qualcomm, Harris Stratex Networks and Oracle. In Oracle, he developed the latest products for the RDBMS and GIS (Geographic Information Systems) applications. He continued developing GIS web-based applications on Tantalus for visualizing meter-devices and monitoring several statistics for several networks. Currently, Enrique is working as the first member of Oracle Multimedia in Oracle Mexico Development Center.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Developing features for the backend in an e-commerce architecture/platform on the cart/checkout microservice. Developing code using Kotlin and Java 10,11 and helping QA staff on creating guidelines for testing our features. Support for bugs on production using several services: splunk, kibana, inspecting logs on linux virtual machines, datadog, consul, jenkins. Assuming leadership and initiative on tackling roadblocks for implementation of features for cart/checkout microservice. Getting involved on microservices that cart/checkout depended on in order to understand how external services were invoked. Helping FE staff to understand how backend api calls were implemented in order to offer solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer (L4)
positions.description: Contributor on developing web-applications solutions for Nextiva on invoicing and billing services and solving bugs/issues on microservices. Implement enhancements for communicating messages using Kafka, coding unit tests using Mockito/Junit and designing integration tests/E2E using Cucumber. Technologies used: Springboot, Docker, Docker Compose, Kafka, Java 11. External services for monitoring application's health: Elastic Search, New Relic, Kibana.

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for all squad's actions in an agile CI/CD based development process.
In charge for translating system requirements into the design and development of customized systems in an agile environment. 
Bringing together end to end applications starting from front end web development, back end development, middleware integration and persisting data in the backend store noSQL or Relational. Working on design, development methodologies and architecture with my squad as well as other IBM squads

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Assuming the lead for the development of the article-redesign for Harvard Business  Review (HBR) website (http://hbr.org). 
Have worked jointly with my development staff and design department in order to build solutions that involve the creation of new front-end components for HBR and a new redesign of the layout of its website. HBR is a website that publishes a myriad of articles that cover various topics for different areas. Such articles can contain many kind of components such as video, images, podcasts, plain-text, advertisements, charts, third-party content,  electronic commerce modules, etc. 
Our goal was to do a redesign of the website (for all the articles that it involves) proposing a new architecture using front-end frameworks such as JQuery/React or simply using JS. We used as well CSS, SASS in order to help us on improving the “look & feel” and styling of the new layout of every article. Additionally, I worked on the backend side, using Java 8 (and above), in order to code the logic and do the parsing of the “articles content” into the frontend. Furthermore, we used Apache Freemarker as a template engine (Java library) in order to generate text output for being used in our HTML webpages.

positions.title: Software Developer Team Lead
positions.description: Leading, mentoring and coaching a team of developers and business analysts in ODO (Amdocs product) by writing code for AT&T on different legacy applications using programming languages such as C/C++/Java/Coldfusion/.NET

positions.title: Professor
positions.description: Professor of the following courses: "Web development", "Object-Oriented Programming"​ and "Linear Algebra" at Universidad Lamar (School of Engineering)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software developer for Oracle Multimedia, a feature of Oracle Database Standard Edition and Enterprise Edition. It provides a platform for a wide range of multimedia applications—patient medical image management for hospitals and research organizations; clinical trial image management for pharmaceutical companies; multimedia asset management for museums, corporations, and the public sector; check image management at financial institutions; asset management for web publishing, video security and many other multimedia intensive applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on a GIS web-based application viewer using Perl, Javascript, HTML, CSS, Python and Selenium for different browsers.

positions.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Developer for Oracle Spatial, which is a team that provides GIS applications to end-users. 
First employee hired in Oracle Mexico Development Center. The Advanced Development Center works together with Oracle USA for bringing the latest products for Oracle Database Releases.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developer of interfaces for Netboss, a Harris Stratex platform. The interfaces
have the goal to provide information about the status of a set of devices of a
client’s network. nbsh is a proprietary language with C and Shell properties
for coding the interfaces.
• Developer of scripts using shell scripting/Perl in SUN servers for Netboss processes.
• Tester of interfaces. To create ATP docs (test cases) and design documents for SNMP and non-SNMP interfaces.
